utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course, I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Dane. I’ll put you on the next task I see.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I’ll check what’s needed for the repair drive and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Could you let me know exactly what parts or tools are needed before you start?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the parts and tools first, then let you know exactly what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can check once I hear what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll go take a look and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can explain what needs fixing, but I need to know which part and whether I can get someone there today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Which part needs fixing, and can someone get there today?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it starts sometime this week, but I’m not sure of the exact day.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive's picking up this afternoon, and folks are saying they're short on volunteers. If you can spare an hour, Gus, it'll help them out a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I can spare an hour and bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's great, Gus — swing by the hall around two, and I'll point you to where they're sorting the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m gathering a few extra names for the repair drive and I’d love to put you on the list, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, put me down for the list. I can help once I know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send you the details and let you know what still needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. What do you need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly do you need fixed on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d need the door hinge tightened, a leaky sink checked, and one broken outlet looked at.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I can slot in any new needs as they come up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll swing by later and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Appreciate it, Bo. I’ll keep the list updated, so just let me know what you find and I’ll add it in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Start with the drive itself and then we’ll work down the list, one thing at a time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, I’ll start with the drive and work through the rest one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that, but I need a bit more detail on what Uli should say in the repair drive conversation.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can be more specific if you tell me what part of the repair drive you want me to cover.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive's getting started soon. I can help connect people if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules. I’m around to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll spread the word and point folks your way if they need help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by the repair drive if you can, Dane. I can send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send the details over now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What does the repair drive need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mostly hands and tools, and maybe a quick look at the wiring first. I’d like to keep it simple and tackle one job at a time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good. I can help sort the wiring first, then we’ll handle the rest one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with that after school pickup. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: How about 4:30 at the community center? That should give us time after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 works for me. I’ll meet you at the community center after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can spread the word and help coordinate if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Jules. I’ll keep telling folks and send anyone your way who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll keep it moving and point anyone interested your way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia. I can bring my drill and a few spare bits if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds helpful, but do you think you can also bring an extension cord? I’m trying to avoid getting stuck halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I can bring the extension cord too so we don’t get stalled out mid-job.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can track that. Where should I note the repair drive drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Please note it at the community center side entrance, next to the donation shelves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll note the drop-off at the community center side entrance by the donation shelves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to check the list first, but I think the main things are whatever’s still broken on the house and anything that needs parts or tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. Can you show me the list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Cleo. Point me at the spot that needs fixing and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll show you the storage closet by the east wall; that’s where the busted latch is.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, show me the latch and I’ll see what needs tightening or replacing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there was a repair drive going on. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I can use a hand sorting donations and maybe running things over, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help sort donations and run things over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is confirmed, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s confirmed. I heard they’re starting it this weekend, so folks are already lining up what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — do we know where the lineup starts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive's getting started soon. Need a hand carrying anything over?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I might take you up on that if I can manage it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No rush, just holler when you know what needs hauling.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I think I can help, unless I already promised Leo something and forgot again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries. If you can take it, I’ll send you the address and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, send it over and I’ll bring what I can.
